components.description: Semantic prospective journey rows with thin dividers, academic titles, and blue tabular numbers.
components.html:
1. 01

    Choose your subject.

    Start with PSAD, MSTE, or HGE. The planned curriculum will keep every subject independently accessible.

  2. 02

    Find your way through.

    Follow a recommended sequence or jump to the topic you need. Prerequisites will offer guidance, without locking lessons.

  3. 03

    Learn it. Then work it out.

    Future lessons will connect clear concepts with engineering examples and practice, so each formula has a reason behind it.

  4. 04

    Return and keep building.

    Once accounts and progress tracking are available, you’ll be able to resume unfinished lessons and keep a record of completed study.

narrative.northStar: Engineering faculty bulletin — white reading surfaces, deep blue ink, academic headings, and a compact section index.
narrative.overview:
CEPath uses the clarity of an engineering faculty bulletin: open reading sheets, academic headings, measured rules, and a small structural mark. The character is modern, calm, and precise, with enough space to read beside notes under ordinary study light.

Engineering identity comes from geometry and orderly typography. Flat surfaces and a restrained blue accent keep attention on the text; oversized promotional heroes, generic SaaS styling, glass effects, and distracting animation are outside the selected direction.
keyCharacteristics: White reading surfaces and lightly tinted supporting fields.
Serif academic hierarchy with clear sans-serif prose and navigation.
Compact visible navigation, a ruled section index, and ordered study rows.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Use the existing blue family for identity and interaction; keep reading surfaces neutral.

rules.name: The Reading Measure Rule
rules.body: Cap sustained prose at 68ch and keep headings distinct through the serif hierarchy.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Group content with spacing, neutral fields, and rules; preserve the open reading sheet.

dos: Do use white reading sheets, the existing blue family, and measured neutral rules.
Do pair Source Serif 4 headings with Source Sans 3 prose and preserve the 68ch reading cap.
Do keep navigation visible on narrow screens, with 44px targets and clear keyboard focus.
Do retain semantic headings, ordered lists, native anchors, the skip link, and reduced-motion support.
donts: Don't introduce generic SaaS card grids, oversized empty heroes, excessive gradients, or glass effects.
Don't add decorative shadows, distracting animation, or a second accent family to this selected world.
Don't present future controls or fabricated progress as part of the existing component system.
